## Purpose 
The nightly pipeline instantiates and precompiles the unmodified manifest. This takes about 8-12 minutes. Then, after the main branches are added, precompilation happens again. I think it would be nice to not precompile initially, because it makes nightly fail much faster when there are compat issues. This makes it easier for the AMIP maintainers to manually trigger a nightly build if needed.

I do this in my own workflow when I want to test if nightly will fail due to compat issues, and I find it to make the proccess much faster.


## To-do
- run nightly on this to verify expected behavior change


## Content
Add `JULIA_PKG_PRECOMPILE_AUTO`  to the initial env instantiation/
